newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss firm Riviera to buy Shell unit.
newsitem.headline: Swiss firm Riviera to buy Shell unit.

text.p: Swiss-based Riviera Participations Holding SA said it was acquiring Symalit AG, a unit of Shell (Switzerland).
The price was set at 30 million Swiss francs, a spokesman for the firm said, elaborating on a company statement.

Symalit produces recyclable thermoplastics for the automobile industry, as well as fluoropolymer products and piping systems for the pharmaceutical, chemical and semi-conductor industry. It also produces polypropylene piping systems for energy distribution, telecommunications and construction industries.
As part of the acquisition, Riviera will increase its share capital to 14 million Swiss francs from currently five milliion via issue of 180,000 bearer shares at 50 francs par value.
Riviera's shares were suspended from Swiss bourse trade earlier on Tuesday pending the announcement.

Riviera will be renamed Quadrant Holding in 1997. Its main investors after the capital increase will be Shell (Switzerland), Coop Bank and Triventus AG, the company said. Triventus is a Swiss corporate finance company.
